newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: CRICKET-OPENER FLOWER SPURS ZIMBABWE TO ONE-DAY WIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-OPENER FLOWER SPURS ZIMBABWE TO ONE-DAY WIN.

text.p: Opener Grant Flower hammered an unbeaten 61 off 69 balls to spur Zimbabwe to only their second one-day victory over India in 15 attempts on Saturday.
Chasing a rain-reduced target of 136 in 38 overs, Zimbabwe swept to an eight-wicket win at 139 for two with 12.1 overs to spare.

Fast bowler Heath Streak had earlier helped to give Zimbabwe the initiative by capturing his career-best of five for 32 as India were dismissed for 168 on a pitch offering both bounce and movement off the seam.

Fellow paceman Eddo Brandes, Zimbabwe's leading wicket-taker with 55 in one-day internationals, also took advantage of the conditions to seize the key wickets of Sachin Tendulkar and Mohammad Azharuddin, finishing with two for 34.

Only opener Vikram Rathore (34), Azharuddin (24) and all-rounder Robin Singh (45) made scores of any substance in a match initially reduced from 50 to 44 overs after light drizzle delayed the start by 45 minutes.

Streak said: "It was nice to do well on my home ground with lots of home support. I bowled with good rhythm today and the wicket was very conducive to bowling seam. Eddo (Brandes) got a few to go through early on and Sachin was a big wicket for us."
Tendulkar said: "The wicket looked okay at the start but, later, it really helped the bowlers. But no excuses - we lost and they played the better cricket."
Zimbabwe began their reply in positive fashion with opener Andy Waller (25) powering five fours before chopping a Doda Ganesh delivery onto his stumps with the total 31.
Two rain breaks reduced Zimbabwe's target to 136 and Flower and captain Alistair Campbell increased the tempo with a second-wicket stand of 65 at a run-a-ball.
Although Campbell was removed by the wrist-spin of Kumble for 24, Flower and Guy Whittall (19 not out) steered Zimbabwe home in a brisk partnership of 43.
The two teams meet in the second and last limited overs match on Monday.
